{{Quote|Let’s hope he’s still in terrified awe of us when he sees that all we’ve got for ID is a pass from the governor.|Atticus to Han Solo|<ref name="COO" />}}
'''Atticus''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who was a part of the contingent invited to the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]]. He and [[Toksi]] were ordered by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] to accompany the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his partner [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] to fly aboard the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'' to a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Golan space defense platform]] and bluff their way in.<ref name="COO" />
